purpose: Development performance as training location groups increase
sampling: Within each outer training fold and state, permute groups once per seed; take nested prefixes using ceiling(fraction * groups).
validation: Existing development folds; unchanged at every fraction
preprocessing: Fit only on each selected training subset
tuning: None; configurations fixed from earlier development analyses
full_fraction: Identical across sampling seeds; fit once per model and fold, not treated as three independent observations.
limitations: Exact coordinates are a grouping proxy, not verified independent sites.
More groups also add recordings and may change species composition.
Exploratory development analysis; model settings previously selected using these development folds.
